newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Thursday were at a standstill following active sales this week that left showlists nearly sold out, market sources said.
Most of this week's sales were at $111.00, with a few at $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis.
A few light packer bids early Thursday at $110.00 were passed by owners who still had a few cattle left to sell that were priced at $112.00, the sources said.
This week's sales were near 75,000 head. Showlists had been estimated from 76,000 to 80,000 head.
